Joining the Amazon Anker summer sale loaded with MagSafe gear, chargers, and accessories from $8, as well as the ongoing AirPods 4 deal at nearly 25% off, we have some additional deals to scope out today as well. This Apple Watch Ultra 3 model is nearly $140 off, here are the M5 MacBook Air configs you can score at $150 off the new list prices, a giant $150 off the latest Bose SoundLink Max Bluetooth Speaker, and a rare deal on Logitech’s latest haptics-enabled MX Master 4 Mouse. All of that and more await below in today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break.

Upgrade your summer audio while AirPods 4 are still nearly 25% off at Amazon

While the Prime Day price on the latest AirPods Pro 3 has jumped up to $219 now, Amazon is remaining steadfast on its AirPods 4 deal at nearly 25% off and has now dropped the AirPods 4 with ANC back down to the same $149 we saw during Prime Day.

Amazon is currently offering the base model AirPods 4 – the most affordable current-generation AirPods you can buy – down at $99 shipped. That’s approaching 25% the list price and on par with this year’s Prime Day price:

  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $149 (Reg. $179)

Now we have been tracking this same deal for a while now, but retailers like Best Buy have now bumped the price back up to the full MSRP at this point, and Amazon might very well follow suit.

Here are the M5 MacBook Air configs you can score at $150 off the new list prices this week

If you are looking to land a new MacBook Air this summer despite the recent price hikes, don’t pay full price at Apple. There are some configurations that are sitting at $150 under the new list prices and Amazon is starting to re-stock additional color options at the discounted rate.

You will now find the Midnight 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,449 shipped. This is the lowest price we have tracked on this model since the price hikes took hold at Amazon, delivering $150 off the new $1,599 list price at Apple.

At this point it does not look like the increased prices are going anywhere, anytime soon, so these “deals” you’ll find at retail are indeed just that. Grabbing a current-gen MacBook Air at $150 off is a solid discount considering the situation Apple has put folks in, and Amazon is at least providing some relief here.

There are a few configs down at $150 off the new list prices right now if the 13-inch 16GB/1TB isn’t working for you, including the base model 15-inch over at B&H – this is the only place we can find online to score a solid discount on the most affordable 15-inch right now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)

Heads up! Logitech’s latest haptics-enabled MX Master 4 just hit the lowest price of the year with a rare deal at $102

We just spotted a deal at Lenovo that drops Logitech’s latest MX Master 4 ergonomic wireless mouse down to $102.59 shipped. Be sure to enter promo code SUMMERLIVE26 and EXTRAFIVE during checkout to see the discounted price. You can get this in Black, Pale Gray, and Graphite finishes, and they’re all down to the $102 mark today. This particular model hasn’t any discounts this year since the last time it dropped in price during the Black Friday sale. It was fetching its full price even during the recent Prime Day sale, so you’re looking at a rather rare deal that marks the lowest price we have tracked for it in 2026. Amazon currently has it for $114 with a $6 on-page coupon, but Lenovo’s offer beats that with an additional $12 discount. Head below for more details.

The MX Master 4 is the latest, upgraded version of Logitech’s popular mouse, which works with both Mac and PC. One of the biggest additions is the new model is the onboard haptic feedback engine, which delivers subtle vibrations as you interact with certain controls and features. You can feel it while moving through the Actions Ring, switching between shortcuts, or carrying out supported gestures, giving the mouse a more responsive and tactile feel during everyday use. It also supports Logitech’s Logi Bolt receiver for a stable and secure wireless connection, alongside Bluetooth for pairing with multiple devices. Other highlights include a familiar ergonomic shape, customizable buttons, precise tracking, and the MagSpeed scroll wheel that has long been one of the highlights of the MX Master series.

This Apple Watch Ultra 3 model just dropped to one of its best prices to date at nearly $140 off

We are still tracking a host of notable discounts across the Apple Watch Ultra 3 lineup with various configurations at nearly $100 off, but Amazon just dropped the price even further on the Natural Titanium model with the latest Blue Trail Loop – it is now nearly $140 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Natural Titanium Case and the Blue/Bright Blue Trail Loop down at $659.97 shipped. That’s $139 off the regular $799 list price and among the best deals we have tracked on Ultra 3.

Up until Prime Day in late June, just about all models maxed out at the same $99 off we are tracking on most configurations right now. We did see this Natural model with the Blue Trail Loop down at $649 for Prime Day, but are now within just $11 of that all-time low and that is the only time it has ever sold for less than it is right now.

Considering the rest of the models on sale right now are at $99 off, chances are this special price drop isn’t going to last for very long.
